V-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Lounge, dining, and standing/BBQ areas are bounded by the building, walls, and dense planting on three or more sides; dining has a pergola canopy.

V-FOCAL.evidence: Fire pit in the lounge area, dining table under pergola, and large citrus tree cluster all compete as primary focal points with no clear hierarchy.

V-AXIS.evidence: Main gravel path leads directly to house doors and connects to lounge, dining, and standing/BBO areas; no dead-end or ambiguous paths visible.

V-RHYTHM.evidence: Large mass of citrus/small trees in the bottom-left corner, a distinct group of four trees in the top-right, and a separate block of herbs in the bottom-right.

V-LAYERING.evidence: Top right shows canopy trees over shrubs and ground cover. Bottom left shows a large canopy tree over multiple shrubs and ground cover. Two distinct planting areas demonstrate full vertical layering.

V-ROOMS.evidence: Distinct zones include a gravel lounge with fire pit, a paved dining area under a pergola, a standing/BBO area, and a separate herbs bed, each with different floor surfaces and uses.

V-OVERALL.evidence: Clear zoning into distinct rooms (lounge, dining, standing/BBQ, pond court), defined edges via walls and planting masses, and structured planting groups (Citrus, herbs, pond court trees).
